name: Deck Hand
shortDescription: A river-thief with a token instead of a name.
lookDescription: A stoat in a tarred jerkin blocks the skiff-line, a wooden token on a cord.
examineDescription: The Deck Hand is a stoat who takes boats that are not his. He is an adult. He is not a student. Solo work. He squares up if you mean to have the landing's painter back.
lockNarration: He sets his paws on the skiff and does not offer a name.
victoryNarration: The Deck Hand drops the token and goes into the willow. The skiff stays.
